source_refs.note: Osmoregulators: a main subheading of 13.2.1 Osmoregulators and Osmoconformers, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 4-4.

blocks.text: The animals that can regulate the concentrations of water and solute in body fluids are osmoregulators. They can maintain constant internal concentrations despite the changing concentration in the environment. They use various mechanisms for osmoregulation e.g., active transport of salts, accumulation of salts, and water conservation etc. Most vertebrates in aquatic and terrestrial environments are osmoregulators.
